toast_invalid_date_format_full: Ifomethi yedethi engavumelekile. Khetha idethi egcwele.
auth_sign_in_subtitle: Finyelela endaweni yakho yokusebenza yasesibhedlela ngokuphephile.
auth_welcome_back_body: Ngena ngemvume ukuze uphathe iziguli, uhlu lwamagama, ama-aphoyintimenti, nokugeleza kokusebenza komtholampilo kwethimba lakho.
auth_welcome_signup_body: Dala i-akhawunti ukuze uphathe iziguli, uhlu lwamagama, ama-aphoyintimenti, nokugeleza kokusebenza komtholampilo kwethimba lakho.
auth_forgot_subtitle: Faka i-imeyili ku-akhawunti yakho. Sizothumela isixhumanisi sokusetha kabusha uma sifana nomsebenzisi obhalisiwe.
auth_check_email_body: Uma i-{email} ibhalisiwe, isixhumanisi sokusetha kabusha sisendleleni. Isixhumanisi siphelelwa yisikhathi emizuzwini engu-15.
auth_otp_subtitle: Sithumele ikhodi enamadijithi angu-6 ku-{email}. Iphelelwa yisikhathi emizuzwini eyi-10.
auth_2fa_subtitle: Faka ikhodi enamadijithi angu-6 kusukela kuhlelo lwakho lokusebenza lokufakazela ubuqiniso.
auth_2fa_setup_subtitle: Qinisekisa iphasiwedi yakho ukuze ukhiqize ikhodi ye-QR yesiqinisekisi.
auth_2fa_setup_scan_subtitle: Skena ngohlelo lwakho lokusebenza lokufakazela ubuqiniso, bese ufaka ikhodi enezinhlamvu ezingu-6.
auth_2fa_setup_success: Ukufakazela ubuqiniso kwezinto ezimbili kunikwe amandla.
auth_2fa_backup_codes_subtitle: Gcina lawa makhodi endaweni ethile ephephile. Ikhodi ngayinye ingasetshenziswa kanye.
auth_2fa_account_hint: Vikela ukungena ngemvume ngohlelo lokusebenza lokufakazela ubuqiniso.
auth_2fa_account_enabled_hint: I-akhawunti yakho ivikelwe ngohlelo lokusebenza lokufakazela ubuqiniso.
auth_2fa_account_disable_hint: Faka iphasiwedi yakho ukuze uvale ukuqinisekiswa kwezinto ezimbili.
auth_2fa_account_change_hint: Faka esikhundleni isiqinisekisi sakho. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhona zizoyeka ukusebenza uze uskene i-QR entsha.
auth_2fa_setup_change_subtitle: Qinisekisa iphasiwedi yakho ukuze umiselele ikhodi yakho ye-QR yesiqinisekisi.
auth_2fa_account_backup_regen_hint: Faka iphasiwedi yakho. Amakhodi ayisipele azoyeka ukusebenza.
auth_2fa_account_backup_regen_success: Amakhodi amasha ayisipele aselungile. Zigcine endaweni ephephile.
session_extend_description: Qinisekisa iphasiwedi yakho ukuze ungeze amanye amahora angu-2 kule seshini.
session_extend_password_hint: Faka iphasiwedi ye-akhawunti ongene ngayo ngemvume. Ungakwazi ukunweba kanye ngeseshini ngayinye.
auth_2fa_account_multi_device_hint: Phakathi nokusetha ungakwazi ukuskena i-QR efanayo ngedivayisi engaphezu kweyodwa.
auth_2fa_required_for_action: Kudingeka ukuqinisekiswa kwezinto ezimbili kulesi senzo. Isethe ukuze uqhubeke.
enter_email_reset_description: Faka i-imeyili yakho futhi sizokuthumelela isixhumanisi sokusetha kabusha iphasiwedi yakho.
invalid_reset_link: Isixhumanisi sokusetha kabusha esingavumelekile noma esiphelelwe yisikhathi. Sicela ucele entsha ngezansi.
password_min_length: Iphasiwedi kumele okungenani ibe nezinhlamvu eziyi-8.
reset_email_sent: Uma ikhona i-akhawunti yale imeyili, isixhumanisi sokusetha kabusha iphasiwedi sithunyelwe.
password_reset_success: Ukusetha kabusha iphasiwedi ngempumelelo. Manje ungangena ngemvume.
op_billing_select_visit_hint: Khetha ukuvakasha ukuze uqale ukukhokhiswa kwe-OP.
op_billing_discount_locked_after_print: Lo mthethosivivinywa wanyatheliswa; isaphulelo sezinga lokuvakasha asinakushintshwa.
op_billing_discount_locked_tooltip: Isephulelo sikhiywa ngemva kokuthi ibhili seliphrintiwe.
op_billing_nothing_to_close: Awekho amasevisi aqediwe asalindiwe ukukhokhiswa kwalokhu kuvakasha.
op_billing_no_services_found: Awekho amasevisi aqediwe alindile ukukhokhiswa kwalokhu kuvakasha.
op_billing_readiness_nursing_hint: Qedela ubuhlengikazi kuqediwe yonke imigqa yesevisi ngaphambi kokuvala.
ip_billing_select_visit_hint: Khetha ukuvakasha ukuze uqale ukukhokhisa nge-IP.
ip_billing_discount_locked_after_print: Lo mthethosivivinywa wanyatheliswa; isaphulelo sezinga lokuvakasha asinakushintshwa.
ip_billing_no_services_found: Awekho amasevisi akhokhelekayo atholakele kulokhu kuvakasha.
no_hospital_assigned: Asikho isibhedlela esinikezwe i-akhawunti yakho. Xhumana nomlawuli wakho.
no_hospitals_yet: Azikho izibhedlela okwamanje. Dala eyodwa ukuze uqalise.
owner_no_hospitals_yet: Azikho izibhedlela okwamanje. Xhumana nomlawuli wakho ukuze uqalise.
hospital_coding_system_help: Ibophezela lesi sibhedlela ezingeni elilodwa lekhodi yokuxilonga ye-WHO. Awukwazi ukushintsha ngemva kokutholakala kokuxilongwa okunekhodi.
hospital_coding_system_locked: Isistimu yekhodi ikhiyiwe ngoba lesi sibhedlela sesivele sinekhodi yokuxilonga.
hospital_coding_release_unknown: Akukho ukungenisa kwekhathalogi ye-WHO okurekhodiwe okwamanje.
icd_who_attribution: Okuqukethwe kwe-ICD-10 kanye ne-ICD-11 kuyi-copyright ye-World Health Organization (WHO). I-ICD-11 ilayisensi ngaphansi kwe-CC BY-ND 3.0 IGO. Ukusetshenziswa kudinga isibaluli; ukuzivumelanisa nezimo kudinga imvume ye-WHO.
docs_coding_standards_body: Isibhedlela ngasinye sibophezela uhlelo lwekhodi yokuxilongwa kwe-WHO (ICD-10 noma i-ICD-11 MMS) ngesikhathi sokudala. Ukusesha kokuxilongwa kwe-EMR kusebenzisa leyo khathalogi kuphela. Amakhathalogi agcwele angeniswa nge-WHO ICD-API kutafula elikhulu okwabelwana ngalo.
name: Igama
admin_no_hospitals_yet: Azikho izibhedlela okwamanje. Dala eyodwa futhi ubophe umnikazi.
admin_team_subtitle: Mema abasizi bese usetha ukuthi yimaphi amakhasi omphathi abangawasebenzisa.
admin_team_need_view: Okungenani ikhasi elilodwa kufanele libe nemvume yokubuka.
admin_team_invite_hint: Bazothola i-imeyili yokusetha kabusha iphasiwedi ukuze basethe iphasiwedi yabo.
admin_team_matrix_hint: Ukubuka kuyadingeka ngaphambi kokudala, ukuhlela, noma ukususa ekhasini.
admin_team_reset_failed: Ayikwazanga ukuthumela i-imeyili yokusetha kabusha iphasiwedi.
admin_monitoring_subtitle: Ukusetshenziswa, umsebenzi wakamuva, kanye nempilo yesizindalwazi.
admin_staff_subtitle: Bonke abasebenzisi abaneqhaza labasebenzi kuzo zonke izibhedlela.
admin_ops_subtitle: Ukusetshenziswa okubukhoma, umsebenzi wakamuva, kanye nempilo yesizindalwazi.
admin_ops_usage_subtitle: Amaseshini kanye nemikhiqizo yakamuva evela kusizindalwazi esibukhoma.
admin_ops_activity_subtitle: Ukungena ngemvume kwakamuva kanye nebhizinisi liyadala.
admin_ops_db_subtitle: Isimo sokuxhuma kanye nesitoreji kusuka ku-PostgreSQL.
admin_ops_db_quota_note: Isabelo sohlelo asivezwa nge-SQL. Bona i-Neon console ukuze uthole isitoreji esitholakalayo.
admin_ops_db_note_size_from_pg: Usayizi wesizindalwazi uvela ku-PostgreSQL pg_database_size (usayizi onengqondo kuleli gatsha le-Neon).
admin_ops_db_note_quota_via_neon: Isabelo sokulondoloza sohlelo lwe-Neon asitholakali nge-SQL. Ukusetshenziswa uma kuqhathaniswa nokutholakalayo kudinga ikhonsoli ye-Neon noma i-Neon API.
admin_ops_db_note_live_counts: Izibalo zerowu zethebula zibukhoma COUNT(*) kumathebula ayinhloko, hhayi izilinganiso ze-pg_stat.
admin_ops_db_note_connection_failed: Uphenyo lokuxhumana lwehlulekile. Hlola i-DATABASE_URL kanye nesimo segatsha le-Neon.
no_owners_yet: Abekho abanikazi okwamanje. Dala eyodwa ukuze ubavumele ukuthi bafinyelele ezibhedlela.
no_user_groups_yet: Awekho amaqembu abasebenzisi okwamanje. Dala eyodwa ozoyabela abasebenzi.
no_user_groups_create: Awekho amaqembu abasebenzisi. Dala eyodwa ngenhla.
no_branches_yet: Awekho amagatsha okwamanje. Engeza igatsha lalesi sibhedlela.
no_user_groups: Awekho amaqembu abasebenzisi atholakalayo kulesi sibhedlela.
user_groups_optional_hint: Khetha iqembu labasebenzisi elilodwa noma ngaphezulu (uyazikhethela).
store_central_help: Okungenani eyodwa egatsheni ngalinye. I-GRN ithumela izimpahla kulesi sitolo. Uma usuvele unesitolo esikhulu kuleli gatsha, sivale lapho ngaphambi kokusivumela lapha.
item_master_barcode_scan_hint: Izikena ze-USB ngokuvamile zithayipha endaweni egxilile. Ukuskena kwekhamera kungangezwa kamuva.
item_master_batch_required_help: Uma inikwe amandla, irisidi yezimpahla kufanele ifake inombolo yenqwaba, idethi yokuphelelwa yisikhathi, kanye nentengo yokuthenga yale nto (okujwayelekile ekhemisi).
item_master_unit_conversions_default_toa: Khetha iyunithi yento kuqala, bese usebenzisa Okuzenzakalelayo ukuze ufanise ukuguqulwa okuhlanganisayo.
Awekho amayunithi wokuguqulwa asebenzisa le yunithi yento ekuthengeni noma ekukhishweni.
item_master_unit_conversions_default_req: Khetha okuzenzakalelayo phakathi kokuguqulwa kweyunithi okufakiwe.
item_master_category_hint: Ukuhlinzekwa Okujwayelekile Kuphela, Ukuhlinzekwa Kwekhemisi, noma Ukunikezwa Kwezokwelapha (kusuka ku-Category Master).
item_master_pharmacy_generic_required: Khetha ijenerikhi yekhemisi yezinto Zokuhlinzeka Ngekhemisi.
no_pharmacy_generics_create: Awekho amajenerikhi ekhemisi. Dala eyodwa ngenhla.
unit_master_empty: Awekho amayunithi okwamanje. Dala eyodwa ngenhla.
no_item_unit_profiles: Akukho ukuguqulwa okwamanje. Dala eyodwa ngenhla.
confirm_delete_refer: Uqinisekile ukuthi ufuna ukususa lesi sithenjwa?
support_unauthorized: Kufanele ungene ngemvume ukuze usebenzise ukwesekwa.
nursing_case_sheet_save_failed: Yehlulekile ukulondoloza ishidi lecala kokunamathiselwe kwisiguli.
nursing_case_sheet_choose_visit: Khetha ukuvakasha usebenzisa inkinobho ethi 'Khetha Ukuvakashela' ngenhla ukuze ubuke ishidi lamacala.
observation_emr_choose_visit: Khetha ukuvakasha usebenzisa inkinobho ethi 'Khetha Ukuvakashela' ngenhla ukuze ubuke idatha yokubuka.
clinical_visit_signed_banner: Lokhu kuvakasha kulondolozwe njengokusayiniwe. Ukubuka nokuhlela kwe-CPOE kukhutshaziwe uze ukhethe okunye ukuvakasha.
clinical_visit_unsign_confirm: Ingabe uqinisekile ukuhlehlisa ukulondoloza njengoba kusayiniwe?
observation_save_as_signed_confirm: Londoloza lokhu kuvakasha njengokusayiniwe? Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa. Ukubuka kanye nokuhlelwa kwe-CPOE kuzokhutshazwa kulokhu kuvakasha; ibhentshi lokusebenzela labahlengikazi lihlala likhona.
observation_emr_casesheet_stub: Uhlelo Lokunakekela alutholakali kulesi sakhiwo. Sebenzisa uhlelo lwe-EMR lokunakekela lapho selulungile.
observation_emr_plan_of_care_empty: Akukho okufakiwe kohlelo lokunakekela kulokhu kuvakasha.
observation_emr_progress_note_stub: Amanothi enqubekelaphambili awatholakali kulesi sakhiwo. Sebenzisa amanothi enqubekelaphambili ye-EMR yobuhlengikazi uma isilungile.
consultation_cpoe_prescription_note_plac: Bhala imiyalelo kadokotela, imithi, umthamo, kanye nezeluleko zesiguli...
consultation_cpoe_prescription_empty: Awekho amanothi kadokotela kulokhu kuvakasha okwamanje.
observation_emr_order_line_locked_op_bil: Lo mugqa usenkokhelweni ye-OP evaliwe futhi awukwazi ukuhlelwa noma ukwenziwa usebenze.
observation_emr_order_line_inactivate_hi: Lo mugqa we-oda uzomakwa njengongasebenzi futhi ukhishwe ekukhokhisweni kwe-OP.
observation_emr_form_entry_inactivate_hi: Thayipha kabusha incazelo yokufaka ngezansi ukuze wenze lokhu kufakwa kusebenze.
delete_owner_confirm_suffix: ? Lokhu kuzosusa i-akhawunti yabo futhi ngeke besakwazi ukungena ngemvume.
prefix_configuration_format_help: Izingcezu ziyahlanganiswa ukuze kwakhiwe ikhodi ngayinye. Engeza umbhalo ongashintshi, izinkambu zedatha, nenombolo esebenzayo.
prefix_configuration_format_empty: Engeza okungenani ucezu olulodwa kufomethi yekhodi.
prefix_configuration_format_load_failed: Ifomethi elondoloziwe ayilayishekanga; kusukela kusakhiwo esimisiwe.
prefix_configuration_page_subtitle: Setha ukuthi amakhodi esiguli, izinombolo zokuvakasha, nezinombolo ze-oda lesevisi zakhiwe kanjani. Inhloso ngayinye isebenzisa ukhiye wesistimu ongashintshi; ushintsha kuphela incazelo nefomethi.
prefix_configuration_purpose_patient_hel: Isetshenziswa lapho kubhaliswa iziguli ezintsha. Uhlobo lokuvakasha alutholakali kule khodi.
prefix_configuration_purpose_visit_help: Isetshenziselwa ukuvakasha kwesiguli ngasinye; ihlanganisa uhlobo lwegatsha nokuvakasha lapho lezo zindawo zikufomethi.
prefix_configuration_purpose_order_help: Isetshenziswa uma udala ama-oda esevisi. Ifomethi ezenzakalelayo ifana ne-YY/vakashela/NNN. Vula "Ukulandelana okuhlukene ngokuvakasha ngakunye" ukuze izinombolo zama-oda zibalwe ngu-001, 002… ngokuvakasha kwesiguli ngakunye (kunconyiwe). Uma ivaliwe, ukulandelana kwabelwa wonke ama-oda asebenzisa ezinye izilungiselelo zesikophu ezifanayo.
prefix_configuration_purpose_pr_help: Isetshenziswa uma udala izidingo zokuthenga (PR). Lungiselela lokhu ngaphambi kokuthi abasebenzi badale ama-PR.
prefix_configuration_purpose_po_help: Isetshenziswa uma udala ama-oda okuthenga (PO). Lungiselela lokhu ngaphambi kokuthi abasebenzi badale ama-PO.
prefix_configuration_purpose_di_help: Isetshenziswa lapho kwakhiwa ama-indenti omnyango. Lungiselela lokhu ngaphambi kokuthi abasebenzi bakwazi ukudala ama-indent.
prefix_configuration_purpose_di_issue_he: Isetshenziswa lapho kwakhiwa izindaba zomnyango kusukela emaphakathi kuya ezitolo ezicelayo.
prefix_configuration_purpose_dc_help: Isetshenziswa lapho kulethwa amadokhumenti okusetshenziswa komnyango ukuze agunyazwe.
prefix_configuration_purpose_med_order_b: Isetshenziswa uma ulondoloza ama-oda emithi yangaphakathi. Yonke imigqa endaweni eyodwa yonga yabelana ngale nombolo yenqwaba. Okuzenzakalelayo kusebenzisa unyaka wezimali, isibhedlela, nokulandelana okusebenzayo.
prefix_configuration_counter_scope_help: Khetha ukuthi iziphi izilinganiso ezihlukanisa inombolo esebenzayo. Ifomethi yokubonisa ngenhla ihlukene; lokhu kuthinta kuphela ukuthi uthola ukulandelana okungakhi okuzimele.
inv_grn_api_hint: Dala ama-GRN nge-POST nge-poId, storeId (maphakathi), receivedDate, kanye nemigqa. Umugqa ngamunye: i-poLineId, i- boughtQty (okungafaki. mahhala), i-batchNo, i-expiryDate, buyPrice (iyadingeka uma into inokulandelela inqwaba). Amaqoqo ajwayelekile (item_batch); isitoko sitholakala ngesitolo ngasinye nenqwaba (inv_stock).
inv_approval_config_intro: Lungiselela amaleveli okugunyaza nabanikezwayo esitolo kanye nohlobo lwedokhumenti oyikhetha ngenhla.
inv_stock_search_modal_hint: Imiphumela yosesho ibandakanya okusesandleni esitolo esikhethiwe (kusuka) kuphela (iyunithi yokukhishwa uma itholakala).
inv_receipt_from_store_view_issue_hint: Ukubuka kuvula leli risidi ekhasini layo; Iyabuya lapha (hhayi odabeni loMnyango).
inv_stock_lot_hint: Imigqa ithi `inv_stock` ihlanganiswe `nenqwaba_yento`, ihlelwe ngokuphelelwa yisikhathi (FEFO).
inv_user_groups_search_placeholder: Hlunga amaqembu abasebenzisi ngamagama noma umazisi...
inv_user_groups_no_filter_match: Awekho amaqembu abasebenzisi afana nalesi sihlungi.
inv_pr_approve_qty_hint: Faka inani eligunyaziwe ngomugqa ngamunye uma kufanele lihluke kulokho okuceliwe. Izilinganiso ezisalindile ze-PR ezisalindile imigqa efanayo evela kulesi sitolo esicelayo (kulindiwe, kubuyiselwe emuva, noma kugunyazwe), okuhlanganisa lesi sicelo.
cpoe_order_pending_empty: Azikho izinto okwamanje. Chofoza + ukuze wengeze into, bese Ulondoloza i-oda.
inv_po_new_lines_need_pr_hint: Khetha isicelo esigunyaziwe sokuthenga ngenhla. Ithebula lizolayishwa lapha nomugqa ngamunye: into, iyunithi (Ukuguqulwa Kweyunithi Eyinhloko), inani elisele, inani le-oda, kanye nenani leyunithi.
inv_po_manual_unit_prereq: Khetha into kuqala, bese ukhetha iyunithi (ukuguqulwa) ohlwini lwento ethi Iyunithi Eyinhloko.
inv_po_manual_unit_none_configured: Le nto ayinakho ukuguqulwa kweyunithi esebenzayo. Zilungise ngaphansi kokusethwa kwe-Inventory → okuyinhloko yento.
inv_po_new_po_pr_cps_only: Khetha isitolo sokuthenga esimaphakathi kubha ephezulu. Izicelo ezigunyaziwe ze-oda elisha lokuthenga zifakwa ohlwini kuphela uma leso sitolo sikhethiwe: zithunyelwa ekuthengeni okumaphakathi, hhayi kwezinye izitolo ezifana nekhemisi okungeyona i-CPS emisiwe.
inv_po_cps_not_configured_pr: Lungiselela isitolo sokuthenga esimaphakathi ngaphansi kokusethwa Kwempahla → Ukulungiselelwa kohlu lwesibhedlela ngaphambi kokudala ama-oda okuthenga avela ezicelweni.
inv_po_close_line_confirm: Vala lo mugqa we-PO bese umaka i-qty esele njengevaliwe?
inv_pr_close_line_confirm: Vala lo mugqa we-PR osele u-qty (setha i-open-for-PO ibe ngu-0)?
inv_grn_receiving_store_none_central: Asikho isitolo esikhulu esilungiselelwe igatsha lale oda lokuthenga. Irisidi yempahla kufanele ithunyelwe esitolo esimaphakathi segatsha. Ekusethweni kwe-Inventory, maka isitolo esisodwa ncamashi negatsha ngalinye njengemaphakathi (isitolo esimaphakathi), bese uyazama futhi.
inv_grn_select_po_for_store_hint: Khetha i-oda lokuthenga ukuze ubone isitolo esamukelayo.
inv_grn_batch_fields_hint: Inombolo yeqoqo, ukuphelelwa yisikhathi, kanye nenani lokuthenga liyadingeka ezintweni ezilandelelwa ngenqwaba.
inv_transfer_pick_batch_hint: Khetha okuningi esitolo somthombo, noma layisha inkatho ngemva kokukhetha izitolo.
inv_hub_subtitle: Ukuthengwa, isitokwe, kanye nokunyakaza kwalesi sibhedlela.
inv_hub_card_po: Dala futhi ugunyaze ama-oda okuthenga, thumela kumnikezeli.
inv_hub_card_grn: Rekhoda irisidi yezimpahla ngokumelene nama-oda okuthenga.
inv_store_central_purchasing_readonly: Ukuthenga okumaphakathi kunikezwa ngaphansi kwe-Inventory config.
inv_setup_central_purchasing_hint: I-PR, i-PO, ne-GRN yezimpahla ezithengiwe zisebenzisa lesi sitolo. Isitolo esikhethiwe simakwe ngokuthi Ukuthenga Okumaphakathi; eyedlule ibuyela kokuthi Okuvamile.
inv_pr_trace_hint: Uma ulayini ugcwele kuma-oda okuthenga, inani elivuliwe ngu-0 lapha; ithrekhi i-odiwe, yamukelwe, futhi kusazotholwa ezikrinini ze-PO ne-GRN.
inv_pr_trace_po_mismatch: Ama-oda okuthenga akhona kule PR kodwa uhlu alukwazanga ukulayishwa. Zama ukuvuselela ikhasi.
inv_pr_list_scope_hint: Ibha ephezulu isetha i-inventory yakho / isicelo (kusuka) esitolo. Uhlu lubonisa izicelo eziphakanyiswe yileso sitolo. Khetha Zonke izitolo ukuze ubone okufunwayo kuzo zonke izitolo ezicelayo, noma sebenzisa isihlungi sekholomu yesitolo ukuze unciphise ngokuthi Kusuka esitolo.
inv_stock_list_scope_hint: Isitoko sikhawulelwe esitolo kubha ephezulu. Khetha Zonke izitolo ukuze ubone zonke izitolo esibhedlela.
inv_di_list_scope_hint: Uhlu lukhawulelwe kuma-indenti aphakanyiswe isitolo kubha ephezulu. Khetha Zonke izitolo ukuze ubone wonke ama-indent omnyango.
inv_flow_procurement_chain: Dala isicelo sokuthenga esitolo esicelayo (ibha ephezulu) → ngemva kokugunyazwa, dala i-oda lokuthenga bese uthumela i-GRN esitolo esitholayo → ohlwini lwe-GRN, sebenzisa i-Transfer ukuze uhambise isitoko esitholiwe esitolo esivule isicelo (lapho i-PR ixhunywe ku-PO).
inv_flow_pr_context: Kusuka esitolo kuvela kubha ephezulu. Khetha okuthi Ongagcina kulesi sicelo.
inv_flow_po_context: Ama-PO esitolo esikhethiwe (ibha ephezulu) alandela izimfuneko zokuthenga ezigunyaziwe noma ukungena mathupha; gunyaza bese uthumela kumnikezeli wempahla ngaphambi kokutholwa kwempahla.
inv_flow_grn_context: Thumela amarisidi esitolo esamukelayo (ibha ephezulu). Uma i-PO ixhunywe esicelweni, sebenzisa i-Transfer ukuthumela isitoko esitolo esicelayo ngemva kokuthumela i-GRN.
inv_po_list_select_store_hint: Khetha isitolo kubha ephezulu ukuze ugxile kulolu hlu, noma usebenzise Wonke ama-oda okuthenga esibhedlela uma kungekho sitolo esikhethiwe.
inv_page_department_issue_subtitle: Isitolo esimaphakathi (ibha ephezulu = Kusuka esitolo) siphakamisa izingqinamba ezitolo ezicelayo: kusuka ku-indent yomnyango egunyaziwe elindele ukuzaliseka, noma mathupha ngaphandle kokuhlehlisa.
inv_flow_dept_issue_context: Njengama-oda okuthenga: sebenzisa Okusha ku-indenti yomnyango lapho isitoko sicelwa esitolo sakho esimaphakathi nge-indenti; sebenzisa iManuwali uma kungekho ukuhlehlisa.
inv_inventory_from_store_topbar_hint: Shintsha isilawuli esithi “Kusuka esitolo” kubha ephezulu (eduze kwegatsha/iqembu labasebenzisi) lapho isigaba se-Inventory sivuliwe.
inv_dept_issue_pending_indents_help: Lawa ma-indenti agunyazwe isitolo esicelayo futhi alinde ukuthi uvule udaba lomnyango. Khetha isitolo esimaphakathi kubha ephezulu.
inv_di_pending_central_fulfill_hint: Dala udaba lomnyango kusuka ku-Inventory → odabeni lomnyango → Okusha kusuka ku-indenti yomnyango (isitolo esimaphakathi kufanele sifane nalesi sitolo se-indenti "kuya" kubha ephezulu).
inv_dept_issue_select_store_hint: Khetha isitolo esimaphakathi (esigcwalisayo) kubha ephezulu. Uhlu lubonisa izinkinga lapho leso sitolo singumkhiphi (Kusuka).
inv_page_receipt_from_store_subtitle: Vuma irisidi esitolo sakho esicelayo (kubha). Ama-indenti akhishiwe avela lapha aze amukelwe.
inv_receipt_from_store_select_store_hint: Khetha isitolo sakho esicelayo kubha ephezulu ukuze ufake kuhlu lwama-indenti alindele ukutholwa kuleso sitolo.
inv_page_department_consumption_subtitle: Rekhoda ukusetshenziswa esitolo ngokubanjwa kweleveli yenqwaba. Thumela ukuze uthole imvume; ukusetshenziswa kokuthunyelwa kokugunyazwa kokugcina futhi kunciphisa isitoko.
inv_dc_list_scope_hint: Uhlu lungalandela isitolo kubha ephezulu noma lubonise zonke izitolo.
inv_dc_configure_dc_approvers: Lungiselela abagunyazi bokusetshenziswa komnyango (imojula DC) yalesi sitolo Ekusethweni Kwempahla → Ukulungiselelwa kokugunyaza.
inv_dc_modal_batch_help: Amaqoqo alayishwa esitokweni esitolo esikhethiwe sale nto.
inv_dc_batch_qty_exceeds_stock: Ubuningi budlula isitoko esitholakalayo seqeqebana elilodwa noma amaningi.
med_order_save_failed: Ayikwazanga ukulondoloza. Hlola okokufaka kwakho bese uzama futhi.
med_order_delete_confirm: Susa lo mugqa? Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.
med_order_batch_pick_help: Faka inani ngeqoqo ngalinye (iyunithi yokuthenga). Amanani avumelaniswa nenkambu yobuningi bomugqa.
med_order_inventory_invalid: Hlola inani leqoqo kanye nentengo yokuthengisa.
med_order_int_missing_master: Lungiselela imvamisa, iyunithi yomthamo, neyunithi yesikhathi ekusethweni kwe-oda Lomuthi, bese uyazama futhi.
med_order_int_past_start: Idethi yokuqala ayikwazi ukuba ngaphambi kwanamuhla.
med_order_int_save_failed: Ukulondoloza kuhlulekile. Hlola umlayezo weseva bese uyazama futhi.
med_order_int_update_failed: Ukubuyekeza kuhlulekile. Hlola umlayezo weseva bese uyazama futhi.
med_order_int_saved: I-oda lomuthi lilondoloziwe. Inombolo entsha yeqoqo yabelwe.
med_order_int_delete_confirm: Susa yonke inqwaba kanye nayo yonke imigqa yayo? Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.
med_order_int_no_batches: Awekho ama-oda emithi alondoloziwe alokhu kuvakasha.
med_order_int_editing: Ukuhlela i-oda elilondoloziwe - izinguquko zisebenza ku-Update.
med_order_int_reorder_stagger_aria: Dala i-oda elisha elilondoloziwe (inqwaba entsha) ukusuka emugqeni wokuqala waleli oda. Isikhathi sokuqala singemva kwesikhathi sokugcina sakamuva kulokhu kuvakasha, noma kusukela manje uma lokho bekuzoba esikhathini esidlule.
med_order_int_reorder_append_confirm: Londoloza i-oda elisha ngenombolo entsha yenqwaba, usebenzisa umugqa wokuqala waleli oda? Isikhathi sokuqala sisethwa ngemva kokuphela komugqa wakho wangaphambilini. Uhlala ohlwini lomlando.
med_order_int_reorder_line_appended: I-oda elisha lilondolozwe ngenombolo yenqwaba entsha.
med_order_int_starts_staggered_toast: Izikhathi zokuqala zilandela ukuhleleka komugqa. Umugqa ngamunye uqala ngemva kwesikhathi esigcwele somugqa odlule. Imvamisa nemithamo ayishintshile.
inv_pr_create_disabled_store_not_requisi: Lesi sitolo asikwazi ukudala izidingo zokuthenga. Vula ukuthenga okudingekayo ku-Store Master.
home_inv_dashboard_subtitle: Ukubuka konke kobubanzi begatsha obukhethiwe kubha yokuzula.
home_inv_dashboard_stock_alerts_hint: Izibalo zihlanganisa izitolo kuphela emagatsheni akho akhethiwe. Izaziso zangaphakathi nohlelo nama-imeyili athunyelwa isitolo ngasinye osibhalisele, futhi ngokuhlukene ngesitoko esiphansi uma siqhathaniswa nokuphelelwa yisikhathi maduze (engeza isitolo ngasinye ngaphansi kokusethwa kwe-Inventory → Izexwayiso zesitoko).
inv_reports_card_dc_desc: Imigqa yokusetshenziswa ethunyelwe enentengo yokuthengisa ye-EMP namanani omugqa.
inv_report_date_range_invalid: Idethi okufanele ibe ngedethi noma ngemuva kwayo kusukela.
inv_reorder_level_subtitle: Setha imikhawulo yesitoko esiphansi ngesitolo ngasinye nento.
inv_reorder_level_min_qty_conversion_hin: Faka ubuncane benani kumayunithi okuthenga; igcinwa njengenani lesitoko (inkinga) kusetshenziswa ukuguqulwa okukhethiwe.
inv_stock_alert_subtitle: Khetha ukuthi yisiphi isitolo esiqapha umuntu ngamunye, kanye nama-toggles e-imeyili kanye newindi eliphelelwa yisikhathi maduzane.
inv_stock_alert_policy_hint: Amawindi okuphelelwa yisikhathi kwento ngayinye angasethwa kokuthi I-Item Master (ikhipha okumisiwe kwesibhedlela ngezansi).
inv_stock_alert_policy_email_channels: Izaziso zangaphakathi nohlelo zilandela amabhokisi okuhlola Abamukeli kuphela. Ukuze uthole nama-imeyili, vula uhlobo ngalunye lwesixwayiso lapha (lulondoloziwe), lungiselela i-SMTP kuseva, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ukungena ngemvume kwe-Auth Engcono kwelungu ngalinye kunekheli le-imeyili.
inv_stock_alert_invalid_days: Izinsuku eziphelelwa yisikhathi-maduze kufanele zibe phakathi kuka-1 no-365.
inv_stock_alert_invalid_gap: Amaminithi wokupholisa kufanele okungenani abe ngu-1.
inv_stock_alert_recipients_hint: Umugqa ngamunye uyisitolo esisodwa kanye nomsebenzi oyedwa. Izaziso zihlanganisa kuphela isitoko saleso sitolo: fanisa ikholomu Yesitolo embikweni wesitoko esiphansi. Sebenzisa isitoko Esiphansi / Amabhokisi okuhlola aphelelwa yisikhathi maduze umugqa ngamunye; Inqubomgomo iphinde ibe nokushintsha kwe-imeyili okuhlukene. Izisebenzi ezabelwe esibhedlela kuphela ezingangezwa.
inv_stock_alert_recipient_exists: Leso sisebenzi sesivele sifakwe ohlwini lwalesi sitolo.
inv_stock_alert_cron_body: Ukuze uthole izexwayiso ezifika ngesikhathi kanye ne-imeyili, shayela le ndawo yokugcina ngeshejuli (isb. njalo ngemizuzu eyi-15). Sebenzisa i-imeyili=1 kuphela uma i-SMTP imisiwe.
inv_stock_alert_cron_secret: Thumela ukugunyazwa kwesihloko: I-Bearer <CRON_SECRET> noma i-x-cron-secret. Setha i-CRON_SECRET endaweni yeseva.
inv_store_markup_percent_invalid: Imakhaphu yesitolo kufanele ibe phakathi kuka-0 no-999.
inv_pricing_template_subtitle: Amafomula entengo yokuthengisa asebenziseka kabusha (MSL, amafulegi ezindleko). Yabela igatsha nemojula ekucushweni Kwamanani.
inv_pricing_template_in_use_warning: Lesi sifanekiso sabelwe igatsha/ububanzi bemojuli ye-{count}.
inv_pricing_assignment_subtitle: Khetha ithempulethi yefomula eyodwa ngegatsha ngalinye nemojula yokuthengisa. Ukugeleza kokuthengisa nokukhipha kusebenzisa isifanekiso esinikeziwe ngesikhathi sokwenziwe.
inv_pricing_assignment_unassigned_warnin: Asikho isifanekiso esabelwe: ukuthengiswa kwale mojula kuleli gatsha kuzohluleka uze unikeze eyodwa.
inv_pricing_assignment_overview_subtitle: Isiphi isifanekiso sefomula esisebenza esibhedlela ngasinye, igatsha, kanye nemojuli.
inv_pricing_config_subtitle: Nikeza isifanekiso sefomula ngegatsha ngalinye kanye nemojula yokuthengisa (ukuthengisa kwangaphakathi, ukuthengisa kwangaphandle, ukusetshenziswa komnyango).
inv_pricing_config_branch_locked_hint: Kusetshenziswa igatsha elisuka kubha yokuzulazula: {branch}. Khetha "Wonke Amagatsha" ku-nav ukuze ukhethe igatsha elihlukile lapha.
inv_pricing_config_sale_help_manual: Faka intengo yokuthengisa kulayini ngamunye we-GRN lapho uthumela.
inv_pricing_config_emp_use_percent_of_sa: Sebenzisa iphesenti lentengo yokuthengisa (ziba izindleko zishintsha ngezansi)
inv_pricing_config_emp_help_manual: Faka inani lentengo yesisebenzi kulayini ngamunye we-GRN lapho uthumela.
inv_pricing_config_invalid_markup: Imakhaphu kufanele ibe phakathi kuka-0 no-999.
inv_pricing_config_invalid_emp_percent: Amaphesenti abasebenzi kufanele abe phakathi kuka-0 no-999.
inv_pricing_preview_hint: Kubalwe kufomula eyabelwe ngesikhathi sokwenziwe (akugciniwe kunqwaba).
inv_pricing_preview_unavailable: Ayikwazanga ukubala ukuhlola kuqala intengo. Hlola isabelo semojula kanye nesixhumanisi se-GRN seqoqo.
item_master_item_markup_percent_hint: Ongakukhetha. Kusetshenziswa endaweni ye-ITEM lapho kubalwa intengo yokuthengisa endaweni ekhishwayo noma ngenkokhiso.
item_master_item_markup_percent_invalid: Umaki wento kufanele ube phakathi kuka-0 no-999.
inv_store_markup_percent_hint: Ongakukhetha. Kusetshenziswe esikhaleni se-STORE uma kubalwa intengo yokuthengisa kulesi sitolo.
item_master_expiry_alert_lead_days_hint: Ongakukhetha. Izinsuku ngaphambi kokuphelelwa yisikhathi ukuhlaba umkhosi inkatho njengoba iphelelwa yisikhathi maduze. Shiya kungenalutho ukuze usebenzise okuzenzakalelayo kwesibhedlela okuvela kuzixwayiso zesitoko.

home_seo_title: Menzies Medora | Ukusebenza kwesibhedlela okuzolile kwawo wonke ithimba lokunakekela
home_seo_description: I-Medora iyi-EMR yezibhedlela eziningi yokubhalisa, ukuvakasha, umsebenzi womtholampilo, i-inventory, kanye nokuphatha. Ikhonsoli eyodwa ye-Soft Wash yabanikazi, abasebenzi, nezitezi zokunakekela.
home_hero_headline: Guqula izinsuku zasesibhedlela zibe ukugeleza okuzolile, okuxhumene
home_hero_body: I-Medora: imisebenzi yokunakekelwa kwezibhedlela eziningi ngokubhaliswa, ukuvakasha, amabhentshi okusebenza emtholampilo, kanye nempahla kukhonsoli eyodwa yomqashi.
home_how_lead: Ukugeleza okukodwa kokungena nokunakekelwa okubhukhiwe. Yakhelwe izikhathi lapho amaqembu anyakazisa iziguli.
home_how_step1_body: Thwebula ubuwena, ukungezwani komzimba nezinto ezithile, nomlando kanye. Njalo ukuvakasha kwakamuva kusebenzisa kabusha ishadi elifanayo.
home_how_step2_body: Dala ukuvakasha kwe-OP noma kwe-IP, namathisela ama-aphoyintimenti, futhi ugcine umongo wegatsha ucacela phansi.
home_how_step3_body: Okubalulekile kwabahlengikazi, ukuxilonga, ama-oda emithi, namadokhumenti aphila emugqeni wesikhathi wokuvakasha ofanayo.
home_how_step4_body: Izinkinga ze-Inventory, ukunikezwa kwenkokhelo, nezinyathelo zokukhipha kuhlala kuxhumene nerekhodi lokuvakasha.
home_modules_lead: Amaphakethe wekhono amboza amadeski okufanele ahlale evumelanisiwe: ihhovisi elingaphambili, izitezi zomtholampilo, izitolo, kanye nokuphatha.
home_modules_registration_body: Inkosi yesiguli, vakashela indalo, ama-aphoyintimenti, nokungena kokwazi igatsha.
home_modules_clinical_body: Amamojula wobuhlengikazi nokubonisana ane-vitals, ukuxilongwa, ama-oda, namanothi e-EMR.
home_modules_inventory_body: Izitolo, amaqoqo, i-PR/PO/GRN, ukusetshenziswa komnyango, nezixwayiso zesitoko.
home_modules_admin_body: Abasebenzi, amagatsha, amaqembu abasebenzisi, ochwepheshe, amadokhumenti, nokusethwa kwesibhedlela.
home_model_heading: I-SaaS eyodwa. Izibhedlela eziningi. Sula izindima.
home_model_lead: IMedora inezibhedlela eziningi ngokuklama. Umsamo udala isibhedlela. Isibhedlela siphethe ukunakekelwa. Iziguli azilidingi ihhovisi lakho elingemuva.
home_model_platform_body: Uhlelo lulawula abanikazi bembewu, izibhedlela, kanye nonogada bonke amasheya abaqashiwe.
home_model_hospital_body: Abanikazi nabaphathi balungiselela amagatsha, izitolo, ukufinyelela kwabasebenzi, kanye nezingcweti.
home_model_staff_body: Abahlengikazi, odokotela, namaqembu ezitolo basebenza ngamamojula aqaphela indima ethile phansi.
home_model_patients_body: Amashadi, ukuvakasha, namadokhumenti kuhlala esibhedlela; abasebenzi basebenzela ikhonsoli.
home_surfaces_nursing_body: Okubalulekile, ukungezwani komzimba nezinto ezithile, amanothi obuhlengikazi, nemisebenzi eseceleni kombhede ngaphandle kokushiya ukuvakasha.
home_surfaces_consult_body: Ukuxilongwa, ama-oda emithi, kanye nemibhalo yomtholampilo yedeski likadokotela.
home_surfaces_inventory_body: Thola, khipha, udlulise, futhi ucwaninge isitoko ngeqoqo kanye nokuqwashisa kokuphelelwa yisikhathi.
home_surfaces_admin_body: Izisebenzi, amagatsha, amaqembu okufinyelela, ochwepheshe bamadokhumenti, nokulungisa.
home_integrated_heading: Gcina ideski ngalinye kumugqa wesikhathi owodwa
home_integrated_lead: Ama-aphoyintimenti, imithi, imibhalo, nokuhanjiswa kwesitoko kwabelana ngokuvakasha ukuze iphansi lihlale liqondile.
home_cta_body: Ngena ngemvume kukhonsoli ye-Medora, khetha isibhedlela, bese uqala kumamojula ithimba lakho eselivele liwasebenzisa.
home_footer_tagline: Imisebenzi yasesibhedlela yokubhaliswa, ukunakekelwa komtholampilo, i-inventory, nokuphatha.
home_scene_aria: Umfanekiso we-Soft Wash wesibhedlela eduze kwezihlahla egcekeni elipholile
pricing_seo_title: Menzies Medora amanani | Ifu kanye ne-On-premise
pricing_seo_description: Amanani entengo ye-EMR yesibhedlela sase-Medora: Ifu ukusuka ku-$99/mo (Ukuqala ukuya ku-Platform). Indawo isebenzisa ama-tiers afanayo ngentengo ye-Cloud + $150/mo ukuze ifakwe nengqalasizinda yakho. Ukubhalisa, umtholampilo, i-inventory, kanye nokuphatha.
pricing_lead: I-Cloud SaaS noma i-On-premise kungqalasizinda yakho. Ama-Starter afanayo, Ibhizinisi, Isikali, kanye ne-Platform. Isayizi yezibhedlela namamojula, hhayi ukukhathazeka kwemitha ngayinye.
pricing_lead_cloud: I-Cloud isingathwe i-Soft Wash Medora: i-SaaS yezibhedlela eziningi, izibuyekezo eziphethwe, nengqalasizinda eyabiwe yawo wonke amasayithi owasebenzisayo.
pricing_lead_onprem: Okukhona yizigaba zomkhiqizo ezifanayo, ezifakiwe futhi zahlelwa kumaseva akho, isizindalwazi, kanye nenethiwekhi. Ungumnikazi wengqalasizinda. Uhlu lwanyanga zonke luyi-Cloud + ${premium} lwalowo mthwalo wemfanelo.
pricing_lead_mmk: Ibonisa i-MMK ku-1 USD = {rate} MMK ukuze uqhathanise nendawo.
pricing_plan_starter_tagline: Isibhedlela esisodwa ku-Soft Wash Medora ephethwe.
pricing_plan_starter_tagline_onprem: Isibhedlela esisodwa i-Soft Wash Medora kwingqalasizinda yakho.
pricing_plan_starter_f6_onprem: Ukwesekwa kwe-imeyili; izibuyekezo endleleni yakho yokukhishwa
pricing_plan_business_tagline: Isitaki esigcwele sasesibhedlela samaqembu okunakekela akhulayo.
pricing_plan_business_tagline_onprem: Isitaki esigcwele sasesibhedlela sifakwe ku-infra yakho.
pricing_plan_business_f4: PR / PO / GRN kanye nezixwayiso zesitoko
pricing_plan_scale_tagline_onprem: Ama-op ezibhedlela eziningi ku-infra yakho ngokuhlanganisa.
pricing_plan_platform_tagline_onprem: Ama-operators asebenzisa izibhedlela eziningi ku-infra yakho.
pricing_plan_platform_f6: Izinketho zokuthumela imiyalezo kanye nedatha yokuhlala
pricing_plan_platform_f6_onprem: Imiyalezo yevolumu kanye nokuba yisakhamuzi esiqinile kunethiwekhi yakho
pricing_who_lead: Inkundla, isibhedlela, abasebenzi, neziguli ngamunye uthola umzila ocacile. Khetha i-Cloud noma i-On-Premise, bese kuba isigaba esifanayo esifana nezibhedlela namamojula owasebenzisayo.
pricing_who_platform_body: Ama-opharetha athola izibhedlela eziningi futhi adinga ilebula elimhlophe kanye ne-SSO. Khetha Inkundla Kumafu noma Ekuphakameni.
pricing_who_hospital_body: Abanikazi nabaphathi abalungisa amagatsha, izitolo, ukufinyelela kwabasebenzi, nezingcweti. Ibhizinisi noma Isikali silingana namaqembu amaningi amasayithi amaningi.
pricing_who_staff_body: Abahlengikazi, odokotela, namaqembu ezitolo kumamojula aqaphela indima ethile. Isikali semikhawulo yezihlalo ngohlelo; iziguli aziliboni ihhovisi elingemuva.
pricing_who_patients_body: Amashadi, ukuvakasha, namadokhumenti kuhlala esibhedlela. Abasebenzi basebenza kusukela kukhonsoli kukho konke ukubhaliswa kuze kube sekuvaliwe.
pricing_faq_q1: Ingabe intengo ngokuvakasha ngakunye noma ngesihlalo ngasinye sabasebenzi?
pricing_faq_a1: Izigaba ezishicilelwe ziyiqembu ngalinye lesibhedlela elinezikepisi zezihlalo. I-Cloud kanye ne-On-premise yabelana nge-Starter, Business, Scale, ne-Platform. Uhlu lwanyanga zonke olusendaweni luyi-Cloud + $150. Ayikho imodi esebenzisa imitha yokuvakasha ngakunye ehamba ngezinsuku ezimatasa.
pricing_faq_a2: Izikhiya zenkokhelo zaminyaka yonke onyakeni ongabikezelwa we-Soft Wash Medora. Isibhedlela sesitayela se-Loomline i-SaaS ivamise ukwehlisa izinhlelo zaminyaka yonke cishe ngo-15 kuya ku-20%. I-Medora isebenzisa isaphulelo sika-20% sohlu lwanyanga zonke uma ukhokha minyaka yonke, kukho kokubili i-Cloud kanye ne-On-premise (ngemuva kwenkokhelo engu-+$150 On-premise).
pricing_faq_q3: Ingabe amamojula wokusungula kanye nomtholampilo afakiwe?
pricing_faq_a3: Isiqalisi sifaka phakathi ukubhaliswa okubalulekile, ukuvakasha, namabhentshi okusebenzela emtholampilo anohlu oluyisisekelo. Ibhizinisi nangaphezulu vula ukugeleza komsebenzi okugcwele kwe-inventory, ama-oda emithi axhunywe kusitoko, kanye nokucushwa komlawuli okucebile. Buza uma udinga izengezo ezilawulwayo.
pricing_faq_q4: Izintengo zomhlaba wonke uma kuqhathaniswa neMyanmar?
pricing_faq_a4: Sebenzisa ukuguqula imakethe ngaphezu kwezinhlelo. I-Global ibonisa i-USD kuphela. IMyanmar ibonisa i-MMK ku-1 USD = 5000 MMK (nge-USD njengomugqa wesibili). Isikhathi sokukhokha kanye nemodi yesevisi kuhlukile emakethe.
pricing_faq_a5: I-Cloud isingathwe i-Soft Wash Medora: i-SaaS yezibhedlela eziningi, izibuyekezo eziphethwe, nokuqala okusheshayo. Indawo isebenzisa ama-tiers afanayo, afakwe engqalasizinda yakho lapho udinga ukulawula noma ukuhlala. I-Infra ingeyakho; uhlu lwanyanga zonke luyi-Cloud + $150 kulowo mthwalo wemfanelo.
pricing_trial_lead: Sitshele ngezibhedlela zakho nokuthi udinga isikhathi esingakanani. Sizolandela nge-imeyili.
pricing_trial_message_placeholder: Amasayithi, inani eliphakeme kakhulu, Ifu noma inketho esendaweni...
pricing_trial_success: Isicelo sesilingo samukelwe. Sizolandelela nge-imeyili maduze.
pricing_trial_error_duration: Khetha ubude besikhathi sokuzama: izinsuku ezingu-7, amaviki angu-2, noma inyanga engu-1.
